note: THE SHAPE s.el REACHES, at its simplest: a `string-match' sets the register, then `replace-match' is handed the SAME string as its STRING argument and RETURNS a new one -- `aXc' -- rather than mutating anything. FIXEDCASE and LITERAL are both t here, which is exactly how s-trim-left and s-trim-right call it (`(replace-match "" t t s)', s.el:41 and s.el:49), so this element alone is what those two functions need. kg answers `void-function'.
